svg.aria-label: Sketch: a night scene outside the Wainwright Health Centre in Alberta. An ambulance stands side-on across the left two-thirds of the frame, cab at the left, its rear doors swung open on a lit interior. Two paramedics in jackets and caps stand with their backs to the viewer at the open doors, drawn as contours with no faces. A second EMS ambulance faces the viewer at the right, partly behind the doors, under the corner of a building. Emergency lights glow as haloed circles on both roofs. The stretcher and patient in the source photograph are left out of the frame. Drawn after a Global News photograph.
